title: ChatRunEventArtifactUpdate
description: SSE payload for `event: artifact_update`, used when an existing artifact is mutated in place instead of announcing a new artifact.

eventId.description: Stable event id for client-side deduplication.

artifactKind.description: Artifact kind being updated. Phase 2 supports topology updates.

updateKind.description: Update payload shape. Phase 2 emits topology overlay patches.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary for logs or toast-style UI.

revision.description: Overlay state revision after this patch is persisted.

patch.description: Self-contained incremental patch for clients that already have the artifact rendered.
